name: PivotField
description: Represents a field in a PivotTable report.
remarks: The PivotField object is a member of the PivotFields collection. The PivotFields collection contains all the fields in a PivotTable report, including hidden fields. In some cases, it may be easier to use one of the properties that returns a subset of the PivotTable fields. The following properties are available: - ColumnFields property - DataFields property - HiddenFields property - PageFields property - RowFields property - VisibleFields property

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Calculation
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlPivotFieldCalculation value that represents the type of calculation performed by the specified field. This property is valid only for data fields.

properties.name: ChildField
properties.description: Returns a PivotField object that represents the child field for the specified field (if the field is grouped and has a child field). Read-only.

properties.name: ChildItems
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single PivotTable item (a PivotItem object) or a collection of all the items (a PivotItems object) that are group children in the specified field, or children of the specified item. Read-only.

properties.name: CurrentPage
properties.description: Returns or sets the current page showing for the page field (valid only for page fields). Read/write PivotItem.

properties.name: DataRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object as shown in the following table. Read-only.

properties.name: DataType
properties.description: Returns an XlPivotFieldDataType value that represents the type of data in the PivotTable field.

properties.name: Function
properties.description: Returns or sets the function used to summarize the PivotTable field (data fields only). Read/write XlConsolidationFunction.

properties.name: GroupLevel
properties.description: Returns the placement of the specified field within a group of fields (if the field is a member of a grouped set of fields). Read-only.

properties.name: HiddenItems
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single hidden PivotTable item (a PivotItem object) or a collection of all the hidden items (a PivotItems object) in the specified field. Read-only.

properties.name: LabelRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the cell (or cells) that contain the field label. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the format code for the object.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlPivotFieldOrientation value that represents the location of the field in the specified PivotTable report.

properties.name: ShowAllItems
properties.description: True if all items in the PivotTable report are displayed, even if they don't contain summary data. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ParentField
properties.description: Returns a PivotField object that represents the PivotTable field that's the group parent of the specified object. The field must be grouped and must have a parent field. Read-only.

properties.name: ParentItems
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single PivotTable item (a PivotItem object) or a collection of all the items (a PivotItems object) that are group parents in the specified field. The specified field must be a group parent of another field. Read-only.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the position of the field (first, second, third, and so on) among all the fields in its orientation (Rows, Columns, Pages, Data).

properties.name: SourceName
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the specified object's name as it appears in the original source data for the specified PivotTable report.

properties.name: Subtotals
properties.description: Returns or sets subtotals displayed with the specified field. Valid only for nondata fields. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: BaseField
properties.description: Returns or sets the base field for a custom calculation. This property is valid only for data fields. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: BaseItem
properties.description: Returns or sets the item in the base field for a custom calculation. Valid only for data fields. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: TotalLevels
properties.description: Returns the total number of fields in the current field group. If the field isn't grouped, or if the data source is OLAP-based, TotalLevels returns the value 1. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the name of the specified field in the PivotTable report.

properties.name: VisibleItems
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single visible PivotTable item (a PivotItem object) or a collection of all the visible items (a PivotItems object) in the specified field. Read-only.

properties.name: DragToColumn
properties.description: True if the specified field can be dragged to the column position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToHide
properties.description: True if the field can be hidden by being dragged off the PivotTable report. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToPage
properties.description: True if the field can be dragged to the page position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToRow
properties.description: True if the field can be dragged to the row position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToData
properties.description: True if the specified field can be dragged to the data position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the object's formula in A1-style notation and in the language of the macro.

properties.name: IsCalculated
properties.description: True if the PivotTable field is a calculated field or item. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: MemoryUsed
properties.description: Returns the amount of memory currently being used by the object, in bytes. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ServerBased
properties.description: True if the data source for the specified PivotTable report is external and only the items matching the page field selection are retrieved. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoSortOrder
properties.description: Returns the order used to sort the specified PivotTable field automatically. Can be one of the XlSortOrder constants. Read-only Long.

properties.name: AutoSortField
properties.description: Returns the name of the data field used to sort the specified PivotTable field automatically. Read-only String.

properties.name: AutoShowType
properties.description: Returns the xlAutomatic constant if AutoShow is enabled for the specified PivotTable field; returns xlManual if AutoShow is disabled. Read-only Long.

properties.name: AutoShowRange
properties.description: Returns the xlTop constant if the top items are shown automatically in the specified PivotTable field; returns xlBottom if the bottom items are shown. Read-only Long.

properties.name: AutoShowCount
properties.description: Returns the number of top or bottom items that are automatically shown in the specified PivotTable field. Read-only Long.

properties.name: AutoShowField
properties.description: Returns the name of the data field used to determine the top or bottom items that are automatically shown in the specified PivotTable field. Read-only String.

properties.name: LayoutBlankLine
properties.description: True if a blank row is inserted after the specified row field in a PivotTable report. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LayoutSubtotalLocation
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the PivotTable field subtotals in relation to (either above or below) the specified field. Read/write XlSubtotalLocationType.

properties.name: LayoutPageBreak
properties.description: True if a page break is inserted after each field. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LayoutForm
properties.description: Returns or sets the way the specified PivotTable items appear-in table format or in outline format. Read/write XlLayoutFormType.

properties.name: SubtotalName
properties.description: Returns or sets the text string label displayed in the subtotal column or row heading in the specified PivotTable report. The default value is the string Subtotal. Read/write String.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the label text for the pivot field.

properties.name: DrilledDown
properties.description: True if the flag for the specified PivotTable field or PivotTable item is set to "drilled" (expanded, or visible). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CubeField
properties.description: Returns the CubeField object from which the specified PivotTable field is descended. Read-only.

properties.name: CurrentPageName
properties.description: Returns or sets the currently displayed page of the specified PivotTable report. The name of the page appears in the page field. Note that this property works only if the currently displayed page already exists. Read/write String.

properties.name: StandardFormula
properties.description: Returns or sets a String specifying formulas with standard English (United States) formatting. Read/write.

properties.name: HiddenItemsList
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant specifying an array of strings that are hidden items for a PivotTable field. Read/write.

properties.name: DatabaseSort
properties.description: When set to True, manual repositioning of items in a PivotTable field is allowed. Returns True if the field has no manually positioned items. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IsMemberProperty
properties.description: Returns True when the PivotField contains member properties. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: PropertyParentField
properties.description: Returns a PivotField object representing the field to which the properties in this field pertain.

properties.name: PropertyOrder
properties.description: Valid only for PivotTable fields that are member property fields. Returns a Long indicating the display position of the member property within the cube field to which it belongs. Read/write.

properties.name: EnableItemSelection
properties.description: When set to False, disables the ability to use the field dropdown in the user interface. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CurrentPageList
properties.description: Returns or sets an array of strings corresponding to the list of items included in a multiple-item page field of a PivotTable report. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Hidden
properties.description: This property is used to hide the individual levels of an OLAP hierarchy. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UseMemberPropertyAsCaption
properties.description: This property is used to control whether member property captions are used for PivotItem captions of the PivotField. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MemberPropertyCaption
properties.description: Setting the MemberPropertyCaption property controls which member property is used as a caption for a given level. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayAsTooltip
properties.description: This property is used to specify whether a specific member property PivotField is displayed in tooltips. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayInReport
properties.description: This property is used to specify whether the specified member property PivotField is displayed in the PivotTable or not. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayAsCaption
properties.description: This property is used to display member properties of PivotFields as captions. Read-only.

properties.name: LayoutCompactRow
properties.description: Specifies whether or not a PivotField is compacted (items of multiple PivotFields are displayed in a single column) when rows are selected. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IncludeNewItemsInFilter
properties.description: Allows developers to specify whether excluded or included items should be tracked when manual filtering is applied to the PivotField. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: VisibleItemsList
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant specifying an array of strings that represent included items in a manual filter applied to a PivotField. Read/write.

properties.name: PivotFilters
properties.description: Returns or sets the PivotFilters for the specified PivotField object. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoSortPivotLine
properties.description: Returns the name of the PivotLine object used to sort the specified PivotTable field automatically. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoSortCustomSubtotal
properties.description: Returns the name of the custom subtotal used to sort the specified PivotTable field automatically. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowingInAxis
properties.description: Indicates if the PivotField is currently visible in the PivotTable or not. Read-only.

properties.name: EnableMultiplePageItems
properties.description: Used for specifying whether check boxes are present in the filter drop-down list for fields in the page area. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AllItemsVisible
properties.description: Used to retrieve a Boolean value that indicates whether any manual filtering is applied to the PivotField. Read-only.

properties.name: SourceCaption
properties.description: The SourceCaption property is applicable only for OLAP PivotTables, and returns the original caption from the OLAP server for a PivotField. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowDetail
properties.description: Gets or sets whether the specified PivotField object is showing detail. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RepeatLabels
properties.description: Returns or sets whether item labels are repeated in the PivotTable for the specified PivotField. Read/write.

methods.name: PivotItems
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single PivotTable item (a PivotItem object) or a collection of all the visible and hidden items (a PivotItems object) in the specified field. Read-only.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or number of the item to be returned.

methods.name: CalculatedItems
methods.description: Returns a CalculatedItems collection that represents all the calculated items in the specified PivotTable report. Read-only.

methods.name: AutoShow
methods.signature: AutoShow(Type As Long, Range As Long, Count As Long, Field As String)
methods.description: Displays the number of top or bottom items for a row, page, or column field in the specified PivotTable report.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Use the xlAutomatic constant to cause the specified PivotTable report to show the items that match the specified criteria. Use xlManual to disable this feature.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location at which to start showing items. Can be either of the following constants: xlTop or xlBottom.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: The number of items to be shown.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: The name of the base data field. You must specify the unique name (as returned from the SourceName property), and not the displayed name.

methods.name: AddPageItem
methods.description: Adds an additional item to a multiple item page field.

parameters.name: Item
parameters.description: Source name of a PivotItem object, corresponding to the specific Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) member unique name.

parameters.name: ClearList
parameters.description: If False (default), adds a page item to the existing list. If True, deletes all current items and adds _Item_.

methods.name: DrillTo
methods.description: The DrillTo method supports drilling to a specified PivotField from another PivotField.

methods.name: ClearManualFilter
methods.description: Provides an easy way to set the Visible property to True for all items of a PivotField in PivotTables, and to empty the HiddenItemsList and VisibleItemsList collections in OLAP PivotTables.

methods.name: ClearAllFilters
methods.description: Calling this method deletes all filters currently applied to the PivotField. This includes deleting all filters from the PivotFilters collection of the PivotField and removing any manual filtering applied to the PivotField as well. If the PivotField is in the Report Filter area, the item selected will be set to the default item.

methods.name: ClearValueFilters
methods.description: Calling this method deletes all value filters in the PivotFilters collection of the PivotField.

methods.name: ClearLabelFilters
methods.description: This method deletes all label filters or all date filters in the PivotFilters collection of the PivotField.

methods.name: AutoSort
methods.signature: AutoSort(Order As Long, Field As String, [PivotLine As Variant], [CustomSubtotal As Variant])
methods.description: Establishes automatic field-sorting rules for PivotTable reports.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: One of the XlSortOrder constants specifying the sort order.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: The name of the sort key field. You must specify the unique name (as returned from the SourceName property), and not the displayed name.

parameters.name: PivotLine
parameters.description: A line on a column or row in a PivotTable report.

methods.name: AutoGroup
methods.description: Automatically groups the pivot fields in a PivotTable.
